units.displayText: [＼(＾∀＾) Choco and Zion!]

spans.text: [＼(＾∀＾) Choco and Zion!]

units.rawText: [(≧∇≦)ﾉ Look there, there!]

spans.text: [(≧∇≦)ﾉ Look there, there!]

units.rawText: Eh? Is it... help from the Oasis?
units.displayText: Eh? Is it... help from the Oasis?

spans.text: Eh? Is it... help from the Oasis?

units.displayText: The robots' hollering soon alerts them, and they notice the two guests from the Oasis.

spans.text: The robots' hollering soon alerts them, and they notice the two guests from the Oasis.

units.displayText: Following the source of the sound, Penumbra spots the other pair of Dolls carrying rescue equipment.

spans.text: Following the source of the sound, Penumbra spots the other pair of Dolls carrying rescue equipment.

units.displayText: Uranus pokes his head out from behind him, greeting them in a very natural manner.

spans.text: Uranus pokes his head out from behind him, greeting them in a very natural manner.

units.rawText: Well met, Ms. Zion, Ms. Choco.
units.displayText: Well met, Ms. Zion, Ms. Choco.

spans.text: Well met, Ms. Zion, Ms. Choco.

units.rawText: Ah, it's... Uranus and...
units.displayText: Ah, it's... Uranus and...

spans.text: Ah, it's... Uranus and...

units.rawText: Penumbra.
units.displayText: Penumbra.

spans.text: Penumbra.

units.rawText: [(￣▽￣)ノWe helped Uranus and Penumbra find Zion and Choco!]
units.displayText: [(￣▽￣)ノWe helped Uranus and Penumbra find Zion and Choco!]

spans.text: [(￣▽￣)ノWe helped Uranus and Penumbra find Zion and Choco!]

units.rawText: [(*^▽^*) There'll be chocolates, right?]
units.displayText: [(*^▽^*) There'll be chocolates, right?]

spans.text: [(*^▽^*) There'll be chocolates, right?]

units.rawText: [(●´▽｀●) Surely, surely.]
units.displayText: [(●´▽｀●) Surely, surely.]

spans.text: [(●´▽｀●) Surely, surely.]

units.rawText: The robots give Choco their full attention, eyes glittering. Choco rummages through a pocket, distributing a small handful of chocolates.
units.displayText: The robots give Choco their full attention, eyes glittering. Choco rummages through a pocket, distributing a small handful of chocolates.

spans.text: The robots give Choco their full attention, eyes glittering. Choco rummages through a pocket, distributing a small handful of chocolates.

units.rawText: Make sure to do your work properly once you're done eating!
units.displayText: Make sure to do your work properly once you're done eating!

spans.text: Make sure to do your work properly once you're done eating!

units.rawText: The little fellas happily rush towards the location of their next assignment with their chocolates.
units.displayText: The little fellas happily rush towards the location of their next assignment with their chocolates.

spans.text: The little fellas happily rush towards the location of their next assignment with their chocolates.

units.rawText: What strange robots...
units.displayText: What strange robots...

spans.text: What strange robots...

units.rawText: Hehe, you get used to it. They're actually the maintenance experts here, and they work with incredible efficiency.
units.displayText: Hehe, you get used to it. They're actually the maintenance experts here, and they work with incredible efficiency.

spans.text: Hehe, you get used to it. They're actually the maintenance experts here, and they work with incredible efficiency.

units.rawText: Right, the Professor sent you to help here, right? Choco's Chocolaterie here in Helios is gone... finally, there's someone to help.
units.displayText: Right, the Professor sent you to help here, right? Choco's Chocolaterie here in Helios is gone... finally, there's someone to help.

spans.text: Right, the Professor sent you to help here, right? Choco's Chocolaterie here in Helios is gone... finally, there's someone to help.

units.rawText: What's the overall status of the Sector?
units.displayText: What's the overall status of the Sector?

spans.text: What's the overall status of the Sector?

units.rawText: Residency Entropization... 45%, Industrial District, 58%... Control Center, 20%, repairs successful.
units.displayText: Residency Entropization... 45%, Industrial District, 58%... Control Center, 20%, repairs successful.

spans.text: Residency Entropization... 45%, Industrial District, 58%... Control Center, 20%, repairs successful.

units.rawText: Most important... Reactor, reactor 1... 3 days not functioning.
units.displayText: Most important... Reactor, reactor 1... 3 days not functioning.

spans.text: Most important... Reactor, reactor 1... 3 days not functioning.

units.rawText: Reactor 1's purpose... Sector energy supply... unrepaired... dangerous.
units.displayText: Reactor 1's purpose... Sector energy supply... unrepaired... dangerous.

spans.text: Reactor 1's purpose... Sector energy supply... unrepaired... dangerous.

units.rawText: The little robots say that the reactor's controls have been Entropized. To stop the expansion of entropization, they had to cut off the reactor entirely.
units.displayText: The little robots say that the reactor's controls have been Entropized. To stop the expansion of entropization, they had to cut off the reactor entirely.

spans.text: The little robots say that the reactor's controls have been Entropized. To stop the expansion of entropization, they had to cut off the reactor entirely.

units.rawText: The energy produced by the reactors is no longer enough to maintain Arche Pyr. If the repairs aren't completed in time, and the Arche Pyr goes out...
units.displayText: The energy produced by the reactors is no longer enough to maintain Arche Pyr. If the repairs aren't completed in time, and the Arche Pyr goes out...

spans.text: The energy produced by the reactors is no longer enough to maintain Arche Pyr. If the repairs aren't completed in time, and the Arche Pyr goes out...

units.rawText: The whole sector will be in trouble!
units.displayText: The whole sector will be in trouble!

spans.text: The whole sector will be in trouble!

units.rawText: Replace Entropized parts... cannot function normally... reactor interior... incident....
units.displayText: Replace Entropized parts... cannot function normally... reactor interior... incident....

spans.text: Replace Entropized parts... cannot function normally... reactor interior... incident....

units.rawText: What about the data display in the control center?
units.displayText: What about the data display in the control center?

spans.text: What about the data display in the control center?

units.rawText: Control center... attempted connection... displayed failure... reactor data inaccessible.
units.displayText: Control center... attempted connection... displayed failure... reactor data inaccessible.

spans.text: Control center... attempted connection... displayed failure... reactor data inaccessible.

units.rawText: Worried... reactor accumulating... recurrence data critical mass... internal pressure causing explosion...
units.displayText: Worried... reactor accumulating... recurrence data critical mass... internal pressure causing explosion...

spans.text: Worried... reactor accumulating... recurrence data critical mass... internal pressure causing explosion...

units.rawText: Explosion? If that happens, we're going to end up in the reset cycle! Not again!
units.displayText: Explosion? If that happens, we're going to end up in the reset cycle! Not again!

spans.text: Explosion? If that happens, we're going to end up in the reset cycle! Not again!

units.rawText: Zzp... if we cannot parse the problem, we cannot come up with a plan. We must find the root of the problem.
units.displayText: Zzp... if we cannot parse the problem, we cannot come up with a plan. We must find the root of the problem.

spans.text: Zzp... if we cannot parse the problem, we cannot come up with a plan. We must find the root of the problem.

units.rawText: If we can't detect the problem from the outside, why not look inside?
units.displayText: If we can't detect the problem from the outside, why not look inside?

spans.text: If we can't detect the problem from the outside, why not look inside?

units.rawText: Connect our own neural clouds, and use ourselves as endoscopes for the reactor's systems?
units.displayText: Connect our own neural clouds, and use ourselves as endoscopes for the reactor's systems?

spans.text: Connect our own neural clouds, and use ourselves as endoscopes for the reactor's systems?

units.rawText: No... interior situation unclear... neural connection... will follow the rest of reactor data... and recur.
units.displayText: No... interior situation unclear... neural connection... will follow the rest of reactor data... and recur.

spans.text: No... interior situation unclear... neural connection... will follow the rest of reactor data... and recur.

units.rawText: Will soon surpass... neural load limit... and then... neural failure follows.
units.displayText: Will soon surpass... neural load limit... and then... neural failure follows.

spans.text: Will soon surpass... neural load limit... and then... neural failure follows.

units.rawText: That is an unnecessary concern. A military Doll's neural load limit is greater, and simple memory recurrence will not have a significant impact.
units.displayText: That is an unnecessary concern. A military Doll's neural load limit is greater, and simple memory recurrence will not have a significant impact.

spans.text: That is an unnecessary concern. A military Doll's neural load limit is greater, and simple memory recurrence will not have a significant impact.

units.rawText: No! You can't!
units.displayText: No! You can't!

spans.text: No! You can't!

units.rawText: Choco tried before! But...
units.displayText: Choco tried before! But...

spans.text: Choco tried before! But...

units.rawText: Choco... Choco... wake up...
units.displayText: Choco... Choco... wake up...

spans.text: Choco... Choco... wake up...

units.rawText: <color=red>Gah... Choco can't make tasty chocolates... no matter how many times she tries...</color>
units.displayText: Gah... Choco can't make tasty chocolates... no matter how many times she tries...

spans.text: Gah... Choco can't make tasty chocolates... no matter how many times she tries...

units.rawText: <color=red>Choco's head hurts...</color>
units.displayText: Choco's head hurts...

spans.text: Choco's head hurts...

units.rawText: After you're connected, all your unpleasant memories get repeated countless times!
units.displayText: After you're connected, all your unpleasant memories get repeated countless times!

spans.text: After you're connected, all your unpleasant memories get repeated countless times!

units.rawText: Zion helped Choco cut the connection quickly... but, but... those memories still encircle me like dark clouds...
units.displayText: Zion helped Choco cut the connection quickly... but, but... those memories still encircle me like dark clouds...

spans.text: Zion helped Choco cut the connection quickly... but, but... those memories still encircle me like dark clouds...

units.rawText: Choco never wants to experience that again, and would never want anyone she knows to be subject to that either.
units.displayText: Choco never wants to experience that again, and would never want anyone she knows to be subject to that either.

spans.text: Choco never wants to experience that again, and would never want anyone she knows to be subject to that either.

units.rawText: But this is the only solution we have.
units.displayText: But this is the only solution we have.

spans.text: But this is the only solution we have.

units.rawText: If the connection is only maintained in a certain time window, the neural pressure should be somewhat reduced. We'll need someone in the control center monitoring the reactor's connection status in real-time.
units.displayText: If the connection is only maintained in a certain time window, the neural pressure should be somewhat reduced. We'll need someone in the control center monitoring the reactor's connection status in real-time.

spans.text: If the connection is only maintained in a certain time window, the neural pressure should be somewhat reduced. We'll need someone in the control center monitoring the reactor's connection status in real-time.

units.rawText: The moment the reactor responds to the connection, we cut it.
units.displayText: The moment the reactor responds to the connection, we cut it.

spans.text: The moment the reactor responds to the connection, we cut it.

units.rawText: Ms. Zion, you are most familiar with the control center. We shall leave the real-time monitoring to you.
units.displayText: Ms. Zion, you are most familiar with the control center. We shall leave the real-time monitoring to you.

spans.text: Ms. Zion, you are most familiar with the control center. We shall leave the real-time monitoring to you.

units.rawText: But everyone...
units.displayText: But everyone...

spans.text: But everyone...

units.rawText: This is the reason we came to the sector, to solve Helios' problems with our own abilities.
units.displayText: This is the reason we came to the sector, to solve Helios' problems with our own abilities.

spans.text: This is the reason we came to the sector, to solve Helios' problems with our own abilities.

units.rawText: If this is how it is, Choco will also...
units.displayText: If this is how it is, Choco will also...

spans.text: If this is how it is, Choco will also...

units.rawText: Ms. Choco...
units.displayText: Ms. Choco...

spans.text: Ms. Choco...

units.rawText: Zion, please focus on your monitoring.
units.displayText: Zion, please focus on your monitoring.

spans.text: Zion, please focus on your monitoring.

units.rawText: If it's something that hurts, Choco wants to help everyone else endure it. So everyone will suffer a bit less.
units.displayText: If it's something that hurts, Choco wants to help everyone else endure it. So everyone will suffer a bit less.

spans.text: If it's something that hurts, Choco wants to help everyone else endure it. So everyone will suffer a bit less.

units.rawText: Seeing the shared resolve of the others, Zion eventually nods and agrees.
units.displayText: Seeing the shared resolve of the others, Zion eventually nods and agrees.

spans.text: Seeing the shared resolve of the others, Zion eventually nods and agrees.

units.rawText: With Zion's guidance, the three make their way to Reactor 1. After explaining things of note in operation, Zion swiftly makes haste for the control center to assist in the procedure.
units.displayText: With Zion's guidance, the three make their way to Reactor 1. After explaining things of note in operation, Zion swiftly makes haste for the control center to assist in the procedure.

spans.text: With Zion's guidance, the three make their way to Reactor 1. After explaining things of note in operation, Zion swiftly makes haste for the control center to assist in the procedure.

units.rawText: Uranus peruses the reactor's access circuits, and a hint of disappointment appears in his voice.
units.displayText: Uranus peruses the reactor's access circuits, and a hint of disappointment appears in his voice.

spans.text: Uranus peruses the reactor's access circuits, and a hint of disappointment appears in his voice.

units.rawText: The situation is even worse than expected. The access points are partially Entropized. Only one access point remains usable.
units.displayText: The situation is even worse than expected. The access points are partially Entropized. Only one access point remains usable.

spans.text: The situation is even worse than expected. The access points are partially Entropized. Only one access point remains usable.

units.rawText: It is largely impossible for three individuals to connect at the same time. We need one Doll to complete a large amount of system checks within a short time window.
units.displayText: It is largely impossible for three individuals to connect at the same time. We need one Doll to complete a large amount of system checks within a short time window.

spans.text: It is largely impossible for three individuals to connect at the same time. We need one Doll to complete a large amount of system checks within a short time window.

units.rawText: Choco has the experience from last time, and understands more about the systems than Uranus and Penumbra. Choco will find the reactor's problems right away.
units.displayText: Choco has the experience from last time, and understands more about the systems than Uranus and Penumbra. Choco will find the reactor's problems right away.

spans.text: Choco has the experience from last time, and understands more about the systems than Uranus and Penumbra. Choco will find the reactor's problems right away.

units.rawText: Do not push your limits. Neural capacity and construction are more reliable than prior experience here.
units.displayText: Do not push your limits. Neural capacity and construction are more reliable than prior experience here.

spans.text: Do not push your limits. Neural capacity and construction are more reliable than prior experience here.

units.rawText: Leave it to me...
units.displayText: Leave it to me...

spans.text: Leave it to me...

units.rawText: I'll handle it.
units.displayText: I'll handle it.

spans.text: I'll handle it.

units.rawText: Before we left, the Professor told me of your situation. A simple neural module and archaic sensory systems.
units.displayText: Before we left, the Professor told me of your situation. A simple neural module and archaic sensory systems.

spans.text: Before we left, the Professor told me of your situation. A simple neural module and archaic sensory systems.

units.rawText: One of the reasons we are here is to find appropriate replacements for you.
units.displayText: One of the reasons we are here is to find appropriate replacements for you.

spans.text: One of the reasons we are here is to find appropriate replacements for you.

units.rawText: If you were to really turn into a piece of scrap, I would not be able to fulfill my duty to the Professor.
units.displayText: If you were to really turn into a piece of scrap, I would not be able to fulfill my duty to the Professor.

spans.text: If you were to really turn into a piece of scrap, I would not be able to fulfill my duty to the Professor.

units.displayText: Spouting stinging words, Penumbra walks towards the reactor's inlet.

spans.text: Spouting stinging words, Penumbra walks towards the reactor's inlet.

units.rawText: To disappoint the Professor is the single greatest humiliation.
units.displayText: To disappoint the Professor is the single greatest humiliation.

spans.text: To disappoint the Professor is the single greatest humiliation.
